plan.design: Stage 1 (screening): For each of 44 positions compute T(p)=sum over all candidate substitutions at p of ESM-2 masked-marginal delta in ONE score_variant call (additivity across distinct positions is exact because all mutated positions are masked). Rank positions by T(p) as a proxy for where ESM-2 most disfavors WT / favors substitution. Stage 2 (localization): score individual substitutions at top-ranked positions. Stage 3 (measurement): query oracle for top ESM-2 candidates and rank by measured fitness.
controls: Same wild-type sequence for all calls
compare against model-card example values (A16C=-6.815, A16D=-9.652).
plan.observation_metric: Per-position T(p) (E1 delta units); individual delta log-likelihood (E1); measured DMS fitness (E3).
plan.refutation_condition: If the top-ranked ESM-2 candidate from the screened+localized positions is not the measured fitness maximum among queried candidates, H1 is refuted for that ranking.
